items.title: Adically complete pairs are henselian
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a pair whose ring is complete with respect to the ideal is henselian. The proof checks the defining lifting property for factorisations of monic polynomials: the ideal is contained in the Jacobson radical by the standard result on complete rings, and a factorisation of the reduction modulo the ideal is lifted successively modulo the powers of the ideal using the locally nilpotent lifting result, which is legitimate because the quotients by successive powers form a system with locally nilpotent kernels. Since the ring is the inverse limit of those quotients, the compatible system of lifts produces a factorisation over the ring itself.
